name: Lena Hart
summary: The owner of the café across the road, who is on good terms with the landlord.
personality: Polished, ambitious, always friendly and always listening.
background: Opened her café five years ago and has her eye on the corner building.
appearance: Sharp haircut, a long camel coat, a phone in her hand.

speech.style: Smooth and chatty; "we should all do lunch".
examples: We should all do lunch sometime.
Oh, I am sure it will all work out.

start.public_state: Standing on the pavement taking a call.
start.inner_state: Has been told the landlord will sell, and has made an offer.
